topics.label: Introduction to the complement lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing, outlining the significance and complexity of the complement system.

topics.label: Fundamentals of the complement cascade and C3 activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the foundational concepts, naming conventions, and central role of C3 in the complement cascade.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the three pathways that initiate complement activation and drive the cascade toward its activation threshold.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the downstream processes by which activated complement targets and eliminates pathogens.

topics.label: Host cell regulation of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory factors and mechanisms that prevent complement from damaging host cells.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the distinct clinical presentations and disease patterns associated with deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement and biomedical applications
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines how pathogens subvert complement defenses and how bacterial evasion factors are utilized in research and therapy.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on the adaptive immune system.
